description: This Java source file defines the `SquashAndStretch` Android activity, which demonstrates a simple animation of a view that squashes and stretches to simulate a bouncing, deforming button. It manages animation sequences including movement and scaling transformations triggered by a button click.

classes.name: SquashAndStretch
classes.description: Main activity class that handles animation of a view with squash and stretch effects upon button clicks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the content view and container reference.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection for adjusting animation speed.

methods.name: onButtonClick
methods.description: Handles the button click event, creates and plays a sequence of animations to demonstrate squash and stretch effects.
